title: design/link.md Engine section and the concepts doc for clock following
description:
## Intent
Record the engine side in the design note and the docs.

## Steps
1. `design/link.md`: an "Engine" section: the clock line, following vs free running, the bridge, trim and resync numbers, the re-render debounce, a Mermaid diagram.
2. `docs/concepts.md`, "From score to sound": one paragraph saying the mixer can follow an outside clock (Link, M2), so edits land on the session's bar lines.

## Verify
`grep -n "Engine" design/link.md`; the docs render in the web app's Docs tab (`npm --prefix web run build` succeeds).

Commit: `docs(<this task id>)`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
